title: ShopeePay Expands Access With PayMongo Integration to Bring Digital Payments Closer to Everyday Life
summary: Get financial insights from ShopeePay Expands Access With PayMongo Integration to Bring Digital Payments Closer to Everyday Life. Learn how PayMongo’s solutions and industry insights can drive growth for your business.
body_markdown:
**MANILA, Philippines —** Monee’s mobile wallet ShopeePay continues its mission to improve financial accessibility to the daily lives of Filipinos through their partnership and integration with PayMongo. This has allowed users to pay across thousands of online and offline merchants, while also giving shoppers more ways to pay and helps businesses provide a smoother, more modern checkout experience.


“We want Filipinos to feel that ShopeePay fits naturally into their everyday routines whether they’re shopping online or visiting their local stores,” said Hazel Sumampong, Head of Product and Marketing at ShopeePay. “Our integration with PayMongo has furthered this vision by making digital payments simpler for users and more rewarding for businesses.”


### **E-Commerce Evolution: From Platforms to Everyday Transactions**


In the early days, digital wallets were often limited to specific platforms. Currently, as ShopeePay extended its reach through PayMongo’s merchant network, it reflects the growing shift toward open, interconnected financial solutions that work across the broader economy.


This milestone highlights how digital payments are becoming a natural part of everyday life, making transactions easier for shoppers and helping businesses connect with a more digital-ready customer base.


The integration has furthered the accessibility of ShopeePay's flexible and consistent payment experiences across even more channels:


- **ShopeePay Wallet** – Pay directly using ShopeePay balance for quick and easy checkouts
- **SPayLater** – Shop now and pay later with flexible payment options
- **MariBank Philippines Inc. (A Rural Bank) (formerly SeaBank)** – Link the MariBank account for smooth and secure transactions


From shopping online to in-store, ShopeePay offers users convenient, reliable payments with the freedom to choose how they pay.


‍


### **Helping Businesses Grow with Modern Payment Options**


For merchants, accepting ShopeePay through PayMongo has opened opportunities to reach millions of ShopeePay users who are already familiar with cashless payments. This has helped businesses improve customer experience, streamline operations, and stay competitive in the evolving digital marketplace.


“We’re excited to have ShopeePay into our merchant ecosystem,” said Matthew Tan, Head of Core Business Products. “This collaboration connects thousands of businesses to one of the country’s leading digital wallets, giving them more ways to engage customers and simplify payments.”


As ShopeePay continues to expand beyond the Shopee app, partnerships like this bring the country closer to a more inclusive digital economy where payments are easy, connected, and accessible to more Filipinos.


‍


**About ShopeePay**


ShopeePay is an integrated mobile wallet that offers users easy access to digital payment services. Launched in Southeast Asia in 2015, ShopeePay enables a seamless shopping experience by allowing users to make online payments on Shopee, top up their wallets, transfer and withdraw funds, and make payments offline at thousands of merchants.


ShopeePay makes it easier to shop and do business. It provides users with a convenient, secure, and rewarding payment option; it empowers businesses and helps them to capture new opportunities.


ShopeePay is part of Monee, the digital financial services arm of Sea Limited. A leading digital payments and financial services provider in Southeast Asia, Monee's mission is to better the lives of individuals and businesses in the region with financial services through technology.​


For more information on ShopeePay and Monee, please visit https://www.monee.com.


‍


**About PayMongo**


PayMongo is the financial operating system for growing businesses in the Philippines. The platform enables merchants to accept, store, send, and borrow money — all in one secure and easy-to-use platform. From startups and SMEs to enterprise-scale merchants, PayMongo simplifies financial infrastructure so entrepreneurs can focus on what matters most: growing their business.


Trusted by tens of thousands of Filipino merchants across retail, food, e-commerce, and services, PayMongo provides the rails that power digital commerce in the country. Regulated by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP), PayMongo is also PCI-DSS 4.0 and SOC 2 Type 2 compliant, ensuring the highest standards of security and reliability.


Learn more at[www.paymongo.com](http://www.paymongo.com/?ref=paymongo-blog.ghost.io) ￼.
